note: The lesson explicitly addresses a terminology drift: Microsoft's portal and older docs/screenshots call this feature "Business domains" (this chapter's and lesson's title), while current learn.microsoft.com pages (unified-catalog-governance-domains, dated 2026-04-21) call the same feature a "governance domain." Domain types, the 5-level/200-domain nesting limits, the four business concepts, and the create-vs-publish role split were all cross-checked directly against unified-catalog-governance-domains and unified-catalog-governance-domains-create-manage.
